findings.title: GitHub - MSNightmare/SignDrop: Windows Common Log FileSystem Authentication 0day Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
findings.summary_md: The researcher publishing as MSNightmare (also known as Nightmare Eclipse and Abdelhamid Naceri) created this repository on November 10, 2026 with working proof-of-concept source code for SignDrop, an unpatched Windows CLFS local privilege escalation. The write-up explains that clfs.sys creates a .cnpf authentication (HMAC) file under a privileged context when a standard user prepares a log and coerces a privileged process to open it, and the resulting file keeps attacker-accessible permissions, yielding SYSTEM access. The proof of concept coerces Windows Defender via its signature update RPC interface and was tested on Windows 11 26H2 and Windows Server 2025 builds. No CVE identifier or patch existed at publication time.
